selection_scope: development only, 138 videos / 147 QA, primary objective 70 main-trackable QA
prior_exposure: The accepted original stage-three report contained full-set results before the video split. No new test rule scores were used for this round.

serialization.format: original raw facts, retained native IDs; no inferred answers
serialization.coordinates: normalized box centers, two decimal places
serialization.omitted_line: Note: {N} additional short, low-confidence, or lower-ranked tracks were omitted.

geometry_parameters.representative: largest sum of confidence; greedily attach non-overlapping adjacent fragments by geometry
geometry_parameters.reid: compare original MASA IDs before/after first observed query-visibility gap; no ID merging for identity decision

public_definition_candidate.implementation: MASA remains 5fps; project visibility to a 3fps nearest-sample grid (max time offset 1/15s), require two absent samples and two consecutive visible samples; backdate confirmed return to first visible sample
public_definition_candidate.limitation: box absence/edge position remain proxies; no SAM masks or mask-area thresholds used

rule.unsupported: partial occlusion and abrupt state changes remain unsupported
rule.numerical: raw 0/1 are retained, covered, illegal, and wrong under official parsing; >=5 maps to 5 or more
rule.coverage: an answer is returned; all-scope accuracy counts abstentions/invalid parses wrong

service_context.reason: Conservative common bound: 32 images each at most 26*26 tokens, each possible donor block budgeted at 12000 tokens, 4096 common-text reserve and 1024 generation reserve; 32768 does not cover this bound.

future_input.timestamps: official sample index / original FPS, formatted to 0.001 seconds, after frames in every condition
future_input.evidence: insert immediately before Question:; A empty, B original 7.3 preface plus facts, C original 7.4, D original 7.5
future_input.numerical_guided_choice: separate diagnostic reruns in all four conditions only; not main strict result

final_retracking: all 689 videos recomputed in tracks/v1/raw after this freeze; development trial raw outputs not reused
